# §14.29 — the SAME BISECT AFTER `0x20800a4c` was served, plus the whole cuInit trace.
#
# boot `w1429_49b182a`, 2026-08-08, vast bench `vh`, real GA106, shipping config,
# `probe-arm set: EMPTY`, STOCK guest module, both stamps
# kayfabe-rev:49b182adeb0d3b63a36afe0c292340dbafbf64c7.
#
# ★★★ THE WALL FELL. All eleven SWEEPIDX rows are NV_OK — including `pos=3 idx=0x2a`,
# which was `0x56` at e6ed6bc — and SWEEPPFX is NV_OK at every length 1..11. The real
# eleven-index call in the trace below now returns `status=0x00000000`.
#
# ⊘⊘ AND cuInit STILL RETURNS 100. The wall MOVED, five ioctls further on:
#
#   0x20800102  status=0x00000000   <- was the wall at e6ed6bc, now served
#   0x20801701  status=0x00000000
#   0x20801823  status=0x00000000   <- BUS_GET_INFO_V2, 3 entries (0x00,0x02,0x0b);
#                                      byte-identical to the real GA106's line 44
#   0x20801801  status=0x00000000
#   0x20801823  status=0x00000056   <- ★ THE NEW WALL: the SECOND call, 6 entries
#   FREE x3, cuInit(0) -> 100
#
# ★ The oracle for it is already committed: `cuinit_ioctl_trace_real_ga106.txt:46` is the
# BYTE-IDENTICAL request, answered `status=0x00000000` by a real part:
#
#   in : 06000000 |0f000000 03000000|10000000 00000000|2c000000 05000000|
#                  2d000000 00000000|03000000 00000000|06000000 00000000
#   out: 06000000 |0f000000 00000000|10000000 07000000|2c000000 00000000|
#                  2d000000 20300003|03000000 033d4500|06000000 00000000
#
# ⚠⚠ AND THE §14.28 TRAP IS PRESENT AGAIN, IN THE SAME SHAPE. Of those six indices only
# ONE is RPC-forwarded on a GSP client: `0x2d` PCIE_GEN_INFO, the first case label of
# `getBusInfos`'s `bSendRpc = IS_VIRTUAL(pGpu) || IS_GSP_CLIENT(pGpu)` group
# (ogkm-580: kern_bus_ctrl.c:283-296). The other five — 0x0f BUS_NUMBER, 0x10
# DEVICE_NUMBER, 0x2c DOMAIN_NUMBER, 0x03 PCIE_GPU_LINK_CAPS, 0x06
# PCIE_DOWNSTREAM_LINK_CAPS — are answered from the guest kernel's own state, and this
# port must NOT write them. `kbusSendBusInfo` forwards ONE ENTRY AT A TIME under
# `NV_CHECK_OK_OR_RETURN` (`:333`), so one refused entry returns for the whole call.
#
# ⊘ `[unmeasured]` What value `0x2d` must carry. `0x03003020` is what ONE part answered.
# PCIE_GEN_INFO describes the LINK, not the die, so it is the `0x23`/`0x24` shape: no
# chip-family row may state it, and it needs an rmladder rung sweeping BUS_GET_INFO_V2 on
# the host (unprivileged, the way R21 obtains GPU_INFO) before anything is written down.
#
Warning: Permanently added '[184.144.255.144]:42525' (ED25519) to the list of known hosts.
